## Liqi Shu, MD

Vascular Neurologist · [UPMC Stroke Institute](https://providers.upmc.com/provider/liqi-shu/4838362)  
Core Faculty · [Pitt Cerebrovascular Medicine](https://www.neurology.pitt.edu/clinical-divisions/cerebrovascular-medicine)  
Adjunct Instructor in Neurology · [Brown University](https://vivo.brown.edu/display/lshu)

Dr. Shu combines vascular neurology, neurointerventional training, and computational methods to improve stroke-risk prediction, clinical data extraction, and recovery measurement. His work draws on EHR data, international registries, imaging, EEG, motion capture, and wearable sensors.

[Email Dr. Shu](mailto:shul@pitt.edu) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uFmbVxEAAAAJ&hl=en) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9784-8475)
:::

## Selected trainee-led and trainee-coauthored work

::: {.outcomes-grid}
::: {.outcome-item}
**Elizabeth Lee**  
First author of a national study comparing carotid and vertebral dissections, with Lukas Strelecky as a coauthor. [View publication →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39647554/)
:::
::: {.outcome-item}
**Lukas Strelecky**  
Coauthor of national work on cervical-dissection incidence trends and recurrent stroke. [View publication →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40173376/)
:::
::: {.outcome-item}
**Henry Zheng & Moxin Wu**  
Coauthors of the externally validated model and public calculator for 30-day peri-procedural stroke risk. [View publication →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42261949/)
:::
::: {.outcome-item}
**Naomi Jack**  
Coauthor of completed work on cardiovascular and bleeding outcomes among surgical patients with atrial fibrillation. [View publication →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38944363/)
